title.en: Saylor teases another Bitcoin buy as Strategy hoard reaches 848,250 BTC
title.zh: Saylor 再发购币暗示：Strategy 持仓已达 848,250 枚 BTC

summary.en: Michael Saylor posted his recurring 'we found room for more orange' chart update on X on October 18, teasing another Strategy Bitcoin purchase. The company's dashboard shows 848,250 BTC held — about 4.04% of the 21 million supply — worth roughly $69.45 billion at an average cost of $75,444 per coin. The tease comes as reported weekly purchases have slowed: the latest reporting week saw only 250 BTC bought while $192.4 million went to STRC preferred-share buybacks.
summary.zh: Michael Saylor 于 10 月 18 日在 X 发布其惯例的“we found room for more orange”持仓图表，暗示 Strategy 将再次买入比特币。公司仪表盘显示其持有 848,250 枚 BTC（约占 2100 万供应总量的 4.04%），价值约 694.5 亿美元，平均成本为每枚 75,444 美元。值得注意的是，公司近期周度购币节奏放缓：最新报告周仅买入 250 枚 BTC，同时将 1.924 亿美元用于回购 STRC 优先股（preferred shares）。

title.en: Cysic suspends bridge after attacker mints 10 million CYS on BNB Chain
title.zh: Cysic 遭攻击：攻击者在 BNB Chain 未经授权铸造 1000 万枚 CYS，跨链桥暂停

summary.en: The Cysic Foundation said on October 18 that an attacker exploited unauthorized database access and a bridge message-processing flaw to mint 10 million CYS on BNB Chain on October 17. On-chain tracking shows the attacker sold about 7.2 million CYS and moved roughly 306.6 ETH (about $727,000) to Ethereum before Cysic blacklisted the receiving address, freezing the remaining 2.8 million CYS. The project says the incident did not affect the Cysic mainnet or existing user assets, and the bridge stays closed until a security review is complete.
summary.zh: Cysic 基金会于 10 月 18 日披露，攻击者于 10 月 17 日利用未经授权的数据库访问与跨链桥消息处理漏洞，在 BNB Chain 上非法铸造 1000 万枚 CYS。链上追踪显示，攻击者在 Cysic 拉黑（blacklist）相关地址前卖出约 720 万枚 CYS，并将约 306.6 枚 ETH（约 72.7 万美元）转移至以太坊（Ethereum）；剩余约 280 万枚 CYS 已被冻结。项目方称事件未波及 Cysic 主网及现有用户资产，跨链桥在安全审查完成前保持关闭。

title.en: Spot Solana ETF outflows extend to ten straight sessions; SOL tests $100
title.zh: 美国现货 SOL ETF 净流出延续至第十个交易日，SOL 考验 100 美元关口

summary.en: U.S. spot Solana ETFs recorded about $12.7 million in net outflows on October 16, their tenth consecutive session of withdrawals, with Bitwise's BSOL accounting for the entire day's exit. Across October 12–16 the funds lost about $25.5 million, though cumulative net inflows still stand near $1.55 billion. SOL slipped to about $103 as traders reduced futures exposure and watched the $100 support level.
summary.zh: 美国现货 SOL ETF 于 10 月 16 日录得约 1270 万美元净流出，为连续第十个交易日净赎回，当日流出全部来自 Bitwise 的 BSOL 产品。10 月 12–16 日期间上述基金累计净流出约 2550 万美元，不过累计净流入仍维持在约 15.5 亿美元。SOL 随之跌至约 103 美元，交易员削减期货敞口，并关注 100 美元支撑位。

title.en: Bitcoin holds near $81,500 in quiet weekend trading; $82,800 in focus for weekly close
title.zh: 比特币周末交投清淡守住 81,500 美元附近，周线收盘聚焦 82,800 美元

summary.en: Bitcoin traded around $81,500 through the weekend in thin liquidity, with technical indicators giving mixed signals: shorter-term moving averages favor sellers while the longer-term structure still supports buyers. Analysts cited $82,800 as the weekly-close level needed to open a path toward $90,000, while a loss of $80,000 could invite a deeper slide. Bitcoin dominance rose to about 60%, signaling defensive positioning as altcoins underperformed.
summary.zh: 比特币在流动性清淡的周末守住 81,500 美元附近，技术指标信号分化：短期均线偏向空方，长期结构仍支撑多方。分析师认为，周线收盘站上 82,800 美元方可打开通往 90,000 美元的空间；若跌破 80,000 美元则可能引发更深回调。随着山寨币走弱，比特币市占率升至约 60%，显示资金转向防御。

title.en: Spot Bitcoin ETFs post $82.4M outflows on October 16 as Ethereum funds shed $69.7M
title.zh: 10 月 16 日美国现货 BTC ETF 净流出 8240 万美元，ETH ETF 净流出 6970 万美元

summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $82.39 million in net outflows on October 16, led by BlackRock's IBIT with $71.78 million in redemptions; Ethereum ETFs lost $69.68 million the same day, entirely from BlackRock's ETHA. The outflows mark a third consecutive losing week for Ethereum products, with roughly $1 billion withdrawn over the three weeks ending October 16. Bitcoin funds remain near $105–106 billion in total assets, so the daily outflow was less than 0.1% of assets.
summary.zh: 美国现货比特币 ETF 于 10 月 16 日录得 8239 万美元净流出，其中贝莱德（BlackRock）IBIT 占 7178 万美元；同日以太坊 ETF 净流出 6968 万美元，全部来自贝莱德 ETHA。此为以太坊产品连续第三周净流出，截至 10 月 16 日的三周累计流出约 10 亿美元。比特币 ETF 总资产仍接近 1050–1060 亿美元，单日流出不足资产规模的 0.1%。

title.en: ECB confirms digital euro plans as Lagarde flags 3.8% euro-area inflation
title.zh: 欧洲央行确认数字欧元（digital euro）计划，拉加德称欧元区通胀达 3.8%

summary.en: ECB President Christine Lagarde confirmed at the IMF Annual Meetings on October 17 that the ECB is preparing a digital euro to complement cash in retail payments, aiming to stimulate innovation and competition while preserving Europe's payments autonomy. The ECB plans a 12-month internal pilot in the second half of 2027, with a first possible issuance in 2029, subject to EU legislation. Lagarde also said September's 3.8% euro-area inflation largely reflected high energy costs expected to ease next year.
summary.zh: 欧洲央行行长拉加德（Christine Lagarde）于 10 月 17 日在 IMF 年会上确认，欧洲央行正筹备数字欧元（digital euro）以在零售支付中补充现金，目标是促进创新与竞争、维护欧洲支付自主权。欧洲央行计划 2027 年下半年开展为期 12 个月的内部试点，并以欧盟立法通过为前提，最早于 2029 年首次发行。拉加德还表示，9 月欧元区 3.8% 的通胀率主要反映能源成本高企，预计明年缓解。

title.en: France's National Assembly narrowly votes to tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps at 31.4%
title.zh: 法国国民议会以 38 比 37 通过修正案：加密资产兑换稳定币将按 31.4% 征税

summary.en: France's National Assembly voted 38–37 on October 16 to adopt Amendment I-3898 to the 2027 Finance Bill, which would make swaps of volatile crypto into MiCA-defined fiat-pegged stablecoins a taxable event from January 1, 2027. The measure ends the deferral that let French investors rotate into stablecoins tax-free until cashing out to euros, applying the flat 31.4% digital-asset gains rate. The text still needs Senate review; Public Accounts Minister David Amiel opposed it, citing tracking complexity.
summary.zh: 法国国民议会于 10 月 16 日以 38 票对 37 票通过 2027 年财政法案修正案 I-3898，拟自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，将加密资产兑换为 MiCA 定义的法定货币挂钩稳定币视为应税事件。该修正案终结了法国投资者在兑换为欧元前可免税转入稳定币的递延政策，适用 31.4% 的数字资产统一资本利得税率（flat rate）。修正案仍需参议院审议；公共账务部长 David Amiel 以追踪复杂为由表示反对。

title.en: Fed Chair Warsh stays tight-lipped on rates; October hike odds collapse
title.zh: 美联储主席 Warsh 对利率路径三缄其口，10 月加息概率骤降

summary.en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh declined to give forward guidance at an economic conference in Bangkok on October 16, saying 'it’s a new chapter at the Fed, and we’re not in that business anymore.' Markets read it as a signal the Fed will hold on October 28: CME FedWatch odds of a hold jumped above 85%, while Polymarket put no-change odds at 87%. Warsh acknowledged inflation pressures remain uncomfortable and that central banks globally are tightening in sync, leaving December as the next open decision point.
summary.zh: 美联储主席 Kevin Warsh 于 10 月 16 日在曼谷一场经济会议上拒绝给出前瞻指引（forward guidance），称“这是美联储的新篇章，我们不再做这项业务”。市场将其解读为 10 月 28 日议息会议将按兵不动：CME FedWatch 显示维持利率不变的概率升至 85% 以上，Polymarket 的无变动赔率达 87%。Warsh 同时承认通胀压力仍令人不安、全球央行正同步收紧，12 月将是下一个开放的决策窗口。

title.en: Solana sets October 21 activation for Alpenglow, targeting ~150ms finality
title.zh: Solana 敲定 Alpenglow 于 10 月 21 日激活，目标实现约 150 毫秒最终确认

summary.en: Solana will activate Alpenglow, its largest consensus overhaul, at the start of epoch 1064 around 15:00 UTC on October 21, replacing TowerBFT. The upgrade targets transaction finality of about 150 milliseconds, down from roughly 12.8 seconds today, by moving validator votes off-chain into direct message exchange with certificates. Validators must run Agave 4.3.0 or later; each vote account must hold 0.8 SOL above its rent-exempt balance under the new Validator Admission Ticket.
summary.zh: Solana 将于 10 月 21 日约 15:00（UTC）在 epoch 1064 起始处激活 Alpenglow——其历史上最大规模的共识机制改革，以取代 TowerBFT。该升级通过将验证者投票转为链下直连消息并聚合成证书（certificates），目标是将交易最终确认（finality）从当前约 12.8 秒降至约 150 毫秒。验证者需运行 Agave 4.3.0 及以上版本，且每个投票账户需在租金豁免余额之外持有 0.8 枚 SOL（Validator Admission Ticket 新规）。

title.en: Babylon Labs proposes native Bitcoin collateral for Aave V4
title.zh: Babylon Labs 提案：将原生比特币（native BTC）引入 Aave V4 作为抵押品

summary.en: Babylon Labs published an ARFC on the Aave governance forum on October 14 proposing native Bitcoin as collateral on Aave V4 through Trustless Bitcoin Vaults. BTC would be locked in Taproot-based arrangements on the Bitcoin network, with Aave recording restricted collateral units inside a dedicated market — no wrapping or custodian required. The proposal remains at the governance-comment stage; risk parameters, a Snapshot vote and an on-chain proposal are still ahead.
summary.zh: Babylon Labs 于 10 月 14 日在 Aave 治理论坛发布 ARFC 提案，拟通过“无信任比特币金库”（Trustless Bitcoin Vaults, TBV）将原生比特币引入 Aave V4 作为抵押品。BTC 将锁定在比特币网络上的 Taproot 脚本安排中，Aave 则在专用市场内记录受限抵押单元——无需封装（wrapping）或托管。该提案目前处于治理评论阶段，风险参数、Snapshot 投票与链上提案尚待推进。

title.en: Standard Chartered opens direct Bitcoin and Ether trading to UAE wealth clients
title.zh: 渣打银行向阿联酋财富客户开放比特币与以太币直接交易

summary.en: Standard Chartered launched direct Bitcoin and Ether trading for affluent UAE clients on October 14, becoming the first international bank to offer such a service in the UAE. Eligible professional investors can trade BTC and ETH through their existing bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept inside the bank's closed-loop system built with Zodia Markets. The service is regulated by Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA).
summary.zh: 渣打银行（Standard Chartered）于 10 月 14 日向阿联酋财富客户推出比特币与以太币直接交易服务，成为首家在阿联酋提供此类服务的国际银行。符合条件的专业投资者（professional investors）可通过现有银行账户直接交易 BTC 与 ETH，托管与结算由银行闭环系统内部完成，技术方案由 Zodia Markets 提供。该服务受迪拜虚拟资产监管局（VARA）监管。

title.en: Cantor Fitzgerald raises 12-month Bitcoin assumption to $112,000, lifts Strategy target to $208
title.zh: Cantor Fitzgerald 将 12 个月比特币预期上调至 11.2 万美元，Strategy 目标价升至 208 美元

summary.en: Cantor Fitzgerald raised its 12-month Bitcoin price assumption to $112,000 from $98,000 on Oct 16, and lifted its Strategy (MSTR) share-price target to $208 from $186 while keeping an Overweight rating. The $112,000 figure feeds directly into its valuation model for Strategy, which holds 848,250 BTC; its enterprise-value estimate rose to $110 billion from $97 billion. The call implies roughly 37% upside from Bitcoin's ~$81,000 market price.
summary.zh: Cantor Fitzgerald 于 10 月 16 日将 12 个月比特币价格预期从 98,000 美元上调至 112,000 美元，同时将 Strategy（MSTR）股票目标价从 186 美元上调至 208 美元，维持增持（Overweight）评级。11.2 万美元的假设直接计入其对 Strategy 的估值模型——该公司持有 848,250 枚 BTC；其企业价值（enterprise value）估计也从 970 亿美元上调至 1100 亿美元。按比特币约 81,000 美元的现价计算，该目标意味着约 37% 的上行空间。

title.en: Ether rebounds about 4% to ~$2,500 as $2,350 support holds; spot ETH ETFs extend weekly outflows
title.zh: 以太坊反弹约 4% 至 2,500 美元附近，2,350 美元支撑守住；现货 ETH ETF 延续周流出

summary.en: Ether bounced roughly 4% to around $2,500 after tapping the $2,350 support zone, with analysts flagging $2,550 as the next resistance — a weekly close above it would signal a bottom, while failure risks one more flush. Thursday saw $60.2 million leave U.S. spot Ether ETFs, putting the funds on track for a second straight week of outflows. Hot U.S. inflation data (CPI 3.7%, PPI 6.3%) and $72 million in liquidations have kept pressure on, though RSI at ~42 is not yet oversold.
summary.zh: 以太坊在测试 2,350 美元支撑后反弹约 4%，升至约 2,500 美元；分析师将 2,550 美元视为下一阻力位——若周线收于其上，将确认底部，否则仍可能再探低点。美国现货以太坊 ETF 周四（10 月 15 日）净流出 6020 万美元，正迈向连续第二周净流出。超预期的美国通胀数据（CPI 同比 3.7%、PPI 同比 6.3%）以及约 7200 万美元的爆仓（liquidations）持续压制市场，不过 RSI 约 42 尚未进入超卖区。

title.en: Bitcoin consolidates near $81,500 above 50-day average; spot ETFs post second straight weekly outflow
title.zh: 比特币在 81,500 美元附近震荡、守住 50 日均线；现货 ETF 连续第二周净流出

summary.en: Bitcoin traded near $81,500 on Oct 17, holding above its 50-day EMA around $80,428 while sitting below the 20-day EMA near $82,648, with RSI near 47 suggesting momentum has cooled since early October. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs posted a second consecutive weekly outflow of about $228.6 million, following $681.1 million the week before, though selling slowed sharply. Bitcoin remains well above its rising 100- and 200-day averages, keeping the broader trend intact.
summary.zh: 10 月 17 日，比特币在约 81,500 美元附近交易，守住 50 日均线（约 80,428 美元）上方，但仍低于 20 日均线（约 82,648 美元）；RSI（相对强弱指数）约 47，显示动能自 10 月初以来降温。美国现货比特币 ETF 当周净流出约 2.286 亿美元，为连续第二周流出，不过抛售力度已较前一周的 6.811 亿美元明显放缓。比特币仍远高于持续上行的 100 日与 200 日均线，中期趋势暂未破坏。

title.en: Crypto ETFs bleed $611M in a week as Ether outflows outpace Bitcoin
title.zh: 加密 ETF 单周净流出 6.11 亿美元，以太坊基金流出超比特币

summary.en: U.S. spot crypto ETFs recorded about $610.7 million in net outflows for the week of Oct 12–16, with Ether funds shedding $320.1 million — outpacing Bitcoin's $228.4 million — while Solana, Zcash and Hyperliquid funds also lost money. Friday was the weakest session, with Bitcoin ETFs losing $82.39 million in a single day, led by BlackRock's IBIT, though weekly outflows still eased from the prior week's $678.9 million. Bitcoin held near $81,000, consolidating just above the $80,000 level as institutional demand wavered.
summary.zh: 美国现货加密 ETF 在 10 月 12–16 日当周净流出约 6.107 亿美元，其中以太坊基金净流出 3.201 亿美元，超过比特币基金的 2.284 亿美元；Solana、Zcash 与 Hyperliquid 相关基金同样失血。周五（10 月 16 日）为单日最弱，比特币 ETF 单日净流出 8239 万美元，主要由贝莱德 IBIT 领衔，尽管周流出规模仍较前一周的 6.789 亿美元明显收窄。比特币守在约 81,000 美元附近，在 80,000 美元上方窄幅震荡，机构需求持续摇摆。

title.en: Scammer gets scammed: Chainalysis says task-scam operator lost 60 BTC (~$4.9M) in Ledger exploit
title.zh: 骗子反被骗：Chainalysis 称某“任务诈骗”团伙在 Ledger 漏洞中损失 60 枚 BTC（约 490 万美元）

summary.en: Chainalysis said Oct 16 that a task-scam operator — who ran fake online-job schemes luring victims with 'negative balance' demands — lost 60 BTC (about $4.9 million) when attackers emptied three Ledger wallet addresses on Oct 9. The wallets used devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, which contained unauthorized hardware implants able to transmit recovery information over a mobile network. The case underscores the reach of the CryptoBilis breach and shows even criminal proceeds were swept into the same laundering chain.
summary.zh: Chainalysis 于 10 月 16 日表示，一名运营“任务诈骗”（以虚假在线兼职诱骗受害者，以“账户负余额”为由要求充值）的团伙，在 10 月 9 日被攻击者清空了三个 Ledger 钱包地址，损失 60 枚比特币（约 490 万美元）。这些钱包使用的是东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的设备，其中含有可通过移动网络传输助记词的非法硬件植入。此案凸显了 CryptoBilis 事件的波及范围，也表明连犯罪所得也被卷入同一条洗钱链条。

title.en: Solana tests $100 as U.S. SOL ETFs post record $24.8M weekly outflow ahead of Alpenglow upgrade
title.zh: Solana 考验 100 美元关口；美国 SOL ETF 单周净流出 2480 万美元创纪录，Alpenglow 升级临近

summary.en: Solana fell about 13% in October to test the $100 level as U.S. spot SOL ETFs recorded a record $24.8 million weekly outflow, ending a 14-week inflow streak; outflows stretched to eight straight days. Bitwise's BSOL accounted for most of the selling, while Solana network activity stayed firm with $3.5 billion of USDC minted on-chain in a week. The Alpenglow protocol upgrade, set for Oct 21 and changing Solana's consensus mechanism, is the next key catalyst.
summary.zh: Solana 10 月累计下跌约 13%，考验 100 美元关口；美国现货 SOL ETF 单周净流出 2480 万美元，创下纪录并终结连续 14 周的净流入，流出天数已连续 8 天。Bitwise 的 BSOL 占抛售的大部分，而 Solana 链上活动依然活跃，单周铸造 35 亿美元 USDC。定于 10 月 21 日的 Alpenglow 协议升级（将改变 Solana 共识机制）是下一个关键催化剂。

title.en: Australia's ASIC consults on up to A$14M capital bar for crypto platforms ahead of 2027 licensing
title.zh: 澳大利亚 ASIC 就加密平台最高 1400 万澳元资本要求征求意见，牌照制度 2027 年生效

summary.en: Australia's ASIC released consultation paper CP 392 on Oct 15 proposing capital, custody and trading standards for digital-asset platforms, with feedback due Nov 27 and final guidance expected in March 2027. One of three capital models would require operators without qualifying third-party custody to hold at least A$14 million in net tangible assets (or 10% of average revenue). The framework, effective April 8, 2027, also restricts proprietary trading and requires quarterly wallet reporting; ASIC has already received over 140 licensing applications.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚证券和投资委员会（ASIC）于 10 月 15 日发布 CP 392 征求意见文件，就数字资产平台的资本、托管与交易标准征求意见，截止 11 月 27 日，最终指引预计 2027 年 3 月发布。三种资本模型之一要求未采用合格第三方托管的运营商持有至少 1400 万澳元有形净资产（或年均收入的 10%，取较高者）。该框架将于 2027 年 4 月 8 日生效，还将限制自营交易并要求按季度报告客户资产钱包；ASIC 已收到超过 140 份牌照申请。

title.en: South Korea approves website blocks on 27 unregistered overseas exchanges including KuCoin and MEXC
title.zh: 韩国批准封锁 27 家未注册海外交易所网站，包括 KuCoin 与 MEXC

summary.en: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit announced Oct 13 that regulators approved blocking domestic access to websites of 27 unregistered overseas virtual-asset operators, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex, BingX and BitMart. Overseas-run sites face access blocking while domestically hosted ones face service termination, extending last year's app-store restrictions to websites. The FIU assesses whether platforms target Koreans via Korean-language services, local marketing or won payments, and warned users they could struggle to access funds.
summary.zh: 韩国金融情报室（FIU）于 10 月 13 日宣布，监管部门已批准封锁 27 家未注册海外虚拟资产运营商的网站国内访问，包括 KuCoin、MEXC、Phemex、BingX 与 BitMart。境外运营的网站将被限制访问，境内托管的网站则终止服务，相当于将去年的应用商店限制扩大到网站层面。FIU 以韩语服务、面向韩国用户的营销和韩元支付支持作为是否面向韩国运营的判断标准，并警告用户可能面临资金提取困难。

title.en: Pando Finance lists Hong Kong's second spot Solana ETF on Oct 13
title.zh: Pando Finance 于 10 月 13 日在香港上市第二只 Solana 现货 ETF

summary.en: Pando Finance listed its spot Solana ETF on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on Oct 13 under code 02831, Hong Kong's second SOL-based spot ETF after ChinaAMC's. The fund charges a 0.6% management fee (about 1.6% in estimated annual ongoing charges), holds SOL without staking, and uses HashKey for trading and custody. It tracks the CME CF Solana-Dollar index's Asia-Pacific close, giving regional investors regulated SOL exposure through brokerage accounts.
summary.zh: Pando Finance 于 10 月 13 日在香港交易所上市其 Solana 现货 ETF（代码 02831），成为香港第二只 SOL 现货 ETF（此前为华夏基金）。该基金管理费为 0.6%（预计年度经常性开支约 1.6%），持有 SOL 但不参与质押（staking），由 HashKey 提供交易与托管服务。基金跟踪 CME CF Solana 美元指数的亚太收盘价，让地区投资者可通过券商账户获得合规的 SOL 敞口。

title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Scheduled for Hoodi Testnet on Oct 26
title.zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级定于 10 月 26 日上线 Hoodi 测试网

summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam network upgrade will activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26, 2026 at 17:42:48 UTC (epoch 132,352), following its October 6 activation on Sepolia. Glamsterdam combines the Amsterdam execution-layer upgrade with the Gloas consensus-layer upgrade, headlined by enshrined proposer-builder separation (EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (EIP-7928). The mainnet activation date has not yet been decided.
summary.zh: 以太坊基金会宣布，Glamsterdam 网络升级将于 10 月 26 日 17:42:48 UTC 在 Hoodi 测试网激活（epoch 132,352），此前已于 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网上线。该升级融合了 Amsterdam 执行层升级与 Gloas 共识层升级，核心内容包括嵌入式提议者—构建者分离（EIP-7732，enshrined proposer-builder separation）与区块级访问列表（EIP-7928，block-level access lists）。主网激活日期尚未确定。

title.en: Bitcoin rebounds toward $83,000 after inflation-driven sell-off; nearly $1B in liquidations
title.zh: 通胀数据引发抛售后，比特币反弹至接近 83,000 美元；杠杆仓位爆仓近 10 亿美元

summary.en: Bitcoin recovered to about $82,750 on October 16 after falling as low as $79,770 the previous day, when hot US inflation data (September CPI 3.7% YoY, PPI up 6.3% YoY) pushed odds of an October Fed rate hike above 50%. Roughly $950 million to $973 million in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated in the sell-off, while easing Treasury yields (10-year retreating to about 5.1%) and dip-buying helped stabilize prices. Ether also recovered, rising about 1.3% to $2,481.
summary.zh: 比特币在 10 月 16 日回升至约 82,750 美元，此前一天曾因超预期的美国通胀数据（9 月 CPI 同比 3.7%、PPI 同比上涨 6.3%）跌至 79,770 美元，美联储 10 月加息概率升破 50%。本次抛售导致约 9.5 亿至 9.73 亿美元的杠杆仓位被强制平仓（liquidations），美债收益率回落（10 年期回落至约 5.1%）与逢低买入帮助稳定了价格。以太币同样反弹，上涨约 1.3% 至 2,481 美元。

title.en: Solana's on-chain RWA value hits $4.3B, reaching 26% of Ethereum's total
title.zh: Solana 链上 RWA 市值达到 43 亿美元，相当于以太坊总量的 26%

summary.en: A Castle Labs report published October 15 found Solana's on-chain real-world asset (RWA) market value grew from about $700 million to $4.3 billion over the past year, lifting it from 4.5% to 26% of Ethereum's $16.6 billion total. Tokenized stocks were a standout, rising from $63 million to $455 million, driven by issuers such as xStocks and Backpack. The report also noted Solana led tracked networks with $193.1 million in application revenue over the past 30 days.
summary.zh: Castle Labs 于 10 月 15 日发布的报告显示，Solana 链上现实世界资产（RWA，real-world assets）市值在过去一年从约 7 亿美元增长至 43 亿美元，占以太坊 166 亿美元总量的比例从 4.5% 提升至 26%。其中代币化股票（tokenized stocks）表现突出，从 6300 万美元增至 4.55 亿美元，主要由 xStocks、Backpack 等发行方推动。报告还指出，Solana 在过去 30 天以 1.931 亿美元的应用收入领跑所追踪的公链。

title.en: SlowMist warns of fake Ledger firmware-update phishing exploiting the CryptoBilis hack
title.zh: SlowMist 警告：不法分子冒充 Ledger 固件更新页面，利用 CryptoBilis 事件实施钓鱼

summary.en: Blockchain security firm SlowMist issued a threat-intelligence alert on October 16 about phishing pages impersonating an official Ledger firmware update, exploiting panic from the CryptoBilis supply-chain incident. The fake pages replicate Ledger's 'Genuine Check' flow, device selection and an 'Update Now' button to trick users into revealing their recovery phrases. SlowMist advises never updating Ledger devices through website links and never entering a recovery phrase anywhere except the device itself.
summary.zh: 区块链安全公司 SlowMist 于 10 月 16 日发布威胁情报警报，称钓鱼页面冒充 Ledger 官方固件更新，利用 CryptoBilis 供应链事件引发的恐慌行骗。这些页面复制了 Ledger 的“Genuine Check”（真伪检测）流程、设备选择界面与“立即更新”按钮，诱导用户泄露助记词（recovery phrase）。SlowMist 建议用户切勿通过网页链接更新 Ledger 设备，也不要在设备以外的任何地方输入助记词。

title.en: XRP ETFs extend inflow streak to 13 weeks as BTC, ETH and SOL funds bleed
title.zh: XRP 现货 ETF 连续 13 周净流入，BTC、ETH、SOL 基金则持续失血

summary.en: US spot XRP ETFs have logged net inflows for 13 consecutive weeks, reaching about $1.80 billion in cumulative inflows, even as XRP net assets fell to roughly $1.57 billion on price declines. In the week ended October 9, XRP funds added $11.31 million while Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs shed a combined $1.25 billion. The streak continued even though the daily inflow slowed to about $740,000 on October 14.
summary.zh: 美国现货 XRP ETF 已连续 13 周实现净流入，累计流入约 18 亿美元，不过受币价下跌影响，净资产降至约 15.7 亿美元。截至 10 月 9 日的一周，XRP 基金净流入 1131 万美元，而同期比特币、以太坊和 Solana ETF 合计净流出 12.5 亿美元。尽管 10 月 14 日单日流入放缓至约 74 万美元，连续流入纪录仍在延续。

title.en: Ledger suspends Southeast Asia resellers after hardware implant drained ~$90M from wallets
title.zh: Ledger 在硬件植入事件盗走约 9000 万美元后，暂停东南亚经销商销售

summary.en: Ledger asked resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales while it investigates tampered devices sold through Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis. Ledger confirmed a hardware implant in an affected device - an extra chip intercepting the 24-word seed phrase - and Bloomberg reported about $90 million stolen across Bitcoin, Ethereum and TRON wallets; on-chain tallies range from roughly $86 million to $102 million. Ledger said its own infrastructure and direct sales channel show no sign of compromise.
summary.zh: Ledger 已要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚和中国香港的经销商与分销商暂停销售，以配合对马来西亚经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的被篡改设备进行调查。Ledger 确认受影响设备存在硬件植入——一块用于拦截 24 词助记词（seed phrase）的额外芯片；据 Bloomberg 报道，比特币、以太坊和波场（TRON）钱包中约 9000 万美元被盗，链上统计范围约为 8600 万至 1.02 亿美元。Ledger 表示其自身基础设施与直销渠道未发现被攻破迹象。

title.en: Strategy bought 250 BTC in week ended Oct 11; holdings reach 848,250 BTC
title.zh: Strategy 在截至 10 月 11 日的一周增持 250 枚 BTC，总持仓达 848,250 枚

summary.en: Strategy disclosed on October 12 that it purchased 250 BTC for approximately $21.5 million during the week of October 5-11, at an average price of about $86,194 per coin. The addition lifts total holdings to 848,250 BTC, acquired for an aggregate cost of roughly $64 billion. The company also repurchased about $192.4 million of its STRC preferred shares over the same period.
summary.zh: Strategy 于 10 月 12 日披露，在 10 月 5 日至 11 日的一周内以约 2150 万美元买入 250 枚比特币，平均买入价约为 86,194 美元/枚。本次增持后，其总持仓达到 848,250 枚 BTC，累计成本约 640 亿美元。同期公司还回购了约 1.924 亿美元的 STRC 优先股。

title.en: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers on Solana for 82M US Galaxy devices
title.zh: 三星钱包将为美国 8200 万台 Galaxy 设备接入 Solana 上的 USDC 转账

summary.en: Samsung Electronics said its Wallet and Pay apps will support USDC transfers on the Solana blockchain for eligible US users starting in the last week of October, covering 82 million compatible Galaxy devices. The feature runs inside the existing Samsung Wallet interface with integrated fiat on/off-ramps, supported by Coinbase as sub-custodian and Bastion for stablecoin infrastructure. Sui is also listed as a supporting blockchain partner.
summary.zh: 三星电子表示，其 Wallet 与 Pay 应用将于 10 月最后一周起支持符合条件的美国用户在 Solana 区块链上进行 USDC 转账，覆盖 8200 万台兼容的 Galaxy 设备。该功能内置于现有三星钱包界面，集成法币出入金通道（fiat on/off-ramps），由 Coinbase 担任次级托管方（sub-custodian），Bastion 提供稳定币基础设施支持。Sui 也被列为支持的区块链合作方之一。

title.en: CFTC proposes first federal crypto trading rules after Clarity Act stalls
title.zh: 在 Clarity 法案受阻后，CFTC 推出首批联邦层面加密交易规则草案

summary.en: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission on October 5 proposed two new rules, Regulation CTX and Regulation CAM, the first federal regulations written specifically for digital-asset trading. The rules would let crypto exchanges opt into a federal regime for margined, leveraged or financed retail crypto trades, bypassing state-by-state licensing. The move follows the Senate's failure to advance the Clarity Act market-structure bill; the public has 60 days to comment.
summary.zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）于 10 月 5 日推出两项新规 Regulation CTX 与 Regulation CAM，这是首批专门针对数字资产交易的联邦法规。该规则允许加密交易所选择加入联邦监管框架，处理面向散户的保证金、杠杆或融资加密交易，从而绕过各州逐州发牌。这一举动发生在参议院未能推进 Clarity 法案市场结构立法之后；公众有 60 天时间提交意见。

summary.en: A hotter-than-expected September US CPI briefly pushed bitcoin below $80,000 for the first time in about a month, before it rebounded toward $82,000. US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $261 million on Wednesday, according to SoSoValue data, while ether fell roughly 5% to near $2,370 and ZEC led the losers. Traders are now watching the October 27-28 Federal Reserve meeting, with markets pricing in a 27% chance of a rate hike.
summary.zh: 美国9月CPI (Consumer Price Index) 超预期升温，比特币一度跌破80,000美元，约为一个月来首次，随后回升至82,000美元附近。据SoSoValue数据，美现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 周三净流出约2.61亿美元；以太币下跌约5%至2,370美元附近，ZEC领跌大盘。市场将目光转向10月27-28日的美联储议息会议，市场预计加息概率为27%。

title.en: Bitcoin Briefly Falls Below $80,000 Then Rebounds to ~$82,000; US Spot ETFs Shed ~$261M
title.zh: 比特币短暂跌破8万美元后反弹至约82,000美元，美现货ETF单日净流出约2.61亿美元

summary.en: Security firm Hacken's Q3 report tallied about $1.18 billion in crypto hack losses across 107 recorded incidents in the third quarter of 2026, the most damaging quarter since Q1 2025. About 77% ($906 million) stemmed from compromised suppliers or developer tools and disclosed-but-undeployed fixes, while smart-contract exploits were the most frequent attack type ($228M across 71 incidents). Roughly $387 million (33%) was returned or reversed, but $384 million remained unrecovered; four incidents (Bitget, Liquid Network, Tectonic, Coldcard) accounted for about 80% of total losses.
summary.zh: 安全公司Hacken的第三季度报告显示，2026年第三季度加密劫案共107起，损失约11.8亿美元，为自2025年一季度 (Bybit 14亿美元事件) 以来最严重的季度。其中约77% (9.06亿美元) 与受损的供应商或开发工具、已披露却未修复的漏洞有关；智能合约漏洞为最频发攻击类型 (71起，损失2.28亿美元)。约3.87亿美元 (33%) 被返还或回滚，但仍有约3.84亿美元未能追回；Bitget、Liquid Network、Tectonic与Coldcard固件漏洞四起事件占总损失的约80%。

title.en: Hacken: Q3 2026 Crypto Hacks Hit $1.18B Across 107 Incidents, Worst Quarter Since Q1 2025
title.zh: Hacken报告：2026年第三季度加密劫案损失达11.8亿美元，为2025年一季度以来最惨重

summary.en: Babylon Labs published an ARFC proposal on Aave's governance forum on October 14 to add native BTC as collateral on Aave V4 through its Trustless Bitcoin Vaults protocol. The design introduces the Babylon Spoke and the BTC Vault Swap Spoke: the former lets users borrow stablecoins against BTC locked on the Bitcoin network, while the latter handles liquidations — without wrapping or bridging BTC. The proposal follows a May temperature check that passed on June 10 and must clear community review and a Snapshot vote before any onchain vote.
summary.zh: Babylon Labs于10月14日在Aave治理论坛发布ARFC提案，拟通过其无托管比特币金库 (Trustless Bitcoin Vaults) 将原生BTC (Native Bitcoin) 引入Aave V4作为抵押品。方案设立Babylon Spoke与BTC Vault Swap Spoke两个组件：前者允许用户以锁定在比特币网络上的BTC抵押借入稳定币 (Stablecoin)，后者负责清算结算，全程无需跨链或包装BTC。该提案沿用了6月10日通过的初步社区投票结果，仍需经社区讨论与快照投票 (Snapshot Vote) 后方可进入链上投票。

title.en: Babylon Labs Advances Aave V4 Proposal for Native Bitcoin Collateral via Trustless Vaults
title.zh: Babylon Labs推进Aave V4原生比特币抵押提案，拟通过无托管金库实现借贷

summary.en: Stronger-than-expected US inflation data triggered heavy selling that pushed ether down nearly 6% to about $2,350 on October 15. CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost reported more than $106 million in Binance ETH long liquidations within one hour following the CPI release, the largest hourly liquidation event in six months. RSI sits near 34 as traders watch support around $2,300, while spot ETH ETFs saw provisional outflows.
summary.zh: 9月美国CPI超预期引发抛售，以太币 (Ether) 周四下跌近6%至约2,350美元。CryptoQuant分析师Darkfost称，CPI发布后一小时内，币安ETH多单被清算逾1.06亿美元，为半年来最大单小时爆仓事件。RSI (Relative Strength Index) 接近34，交易员正关注2,300美元附近的支撑位；现货以太币ETF (Spot ETH ETF) 亦录得初步资金流出。

title.en: Ether Drops Nearly 6% to ~$2,350 as $106M in ETH Longs Liquidated in One Hour on Binance
title.zh: 以太币下跌近6%至约2,350美元，币安ETH多单一小时内爆仓逾1.06亿美元

summary.en: Solana fell below $102 on Thursday, extending its October decline to about 13% after a double-top reversal near $122. SoSoValue data showed spot SOL ETFs recorded roughly $1.3 million in net outflows on Wednesday, the eighth consecutive day of withdrawals, following $24.81 million the previous week. Meanwhile, tokenized equity supply on Solana rose to about $611 million across 1.42 million holders. RSI near 35 leaves $100 as the key psychological level, with 200-day EMA support at $97.95.
summary.zh: Solana (SOL) 周四跌破102美元，10月以来累计下跌约13%，月初曾在122美元附近形成双顶反转。SoSoValue数据显示，SOL现货ETF周三净流出约130万美元，为连续第八天净流出，上周累计流出2,481万美元。与此同时，Solana链上股权代币 (Tokenized Equity) 供应量升至约6.11亿美元，分布在142万持有人手中。RSI接近35，100美元成为关键心理关口，下方支撑在200日均线约97.95美元。

title.en: SOL Drops Below $102 as ETF Outflows Extend to Eighth Straight Day; Tokenized Equity Tops $611M
title.zh: SOL跌破102美元，ETF连续第八天净流出；Solana链上股权代币化规模超6.11亿美元

summary.en: Network data suggests Bitcoin's mining difficulty will rise about 5.68% around October 16 at block 971,712, the third-largest increase of 2026. Hashprice would fall from roughly $39.77 to about $37.63 per PH/day, cutting revenue per unit of computing power by about 5.37%. The projection reflects blocks arriving every 9.49 minutes, faster than the protocol's 10-minute target, as hashrate holds near 1 ZH/s — a sign miners keep adding capacity even with BTC under $82,000.
summary.zh: 网络数据显示，比特币挖矿难度 (Mining Difficulty) 将于10月16日区块971,712处上调约5.68%，为2026年第三大涨幅。哈希价格 (Hashprice) 将从约39.77美元降至37.63美元/日/PH，单位算力收入下降约5.37%。此次上调源于出块间隔约为9.49分钟、快于协议10分钟目标，全网算力维持在约1 ZH/s附近——表明即使在BTC低于82,000美元的情况下，矿工仍在持续加码。

title.en: Bitcoin Mining Difficulty Projected to Jump ~5.7% on October 16, Third-Biggest Rise of 2026
title.zh: 比特币挖矿难度预计10月16日上调约5.7%，为2026年第三大涨幅

summary.en: VanEck Digital Assets filed to withdraw its Lido Staked Ethereum ETF registration with the SEC on October 14, ending plans for a fund that would have held Lido's stETH. The firm confirmed the registration never became effective and no shares were issued or sold, without disclosing a reason for the withdrawal. The decision ends this specific proposal but does not establish a new SEC position on liquid staking tokens more broadly.
summary.zh: VanEck Digital Assets于10月14日向SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission) 提交撤回文件，终止其Lido质押以太币ETF (Staked Ether ETF) 的注册计划。该基金原计划持有Lido的stETH；VanEck确认注册从未生效，未发行任何份额，亦未披露撤回原因。此举仅终结该特定产品，并不构成SEC对流动性质押代币 (Liquid Staking Token) 的新立场。

title.en: VanEck Withdraws Lido Staked Ether ETF Registration; No Shares Were Ever Issued
title.zh: VanEck撤回Lido质押以太币ETF注册申请，基金从未发行

summary.en: Tether froze about $10 million in USDT linked to the theft of funds from Ledger devices sold by Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery raised its estimate of the losses to about $102 million taken from 324 wallets across six blockchains, mostly USDT on TRON. Ledger previously confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in an affected device that could capture the 24-word recovery phrase during setup, and advised CryptoBilis customers to move assets to new devices with fresh seed phrases.
summary.zh: Tether冻结了约1,000万美元与马来西亚经销商CryptoBilis所售Ledger设备劫案相关的USDT。区块链分析公司Bitquery将损失估计上调至约1.02亿美元，涉324个钱包、横跨六条区块链，大部分为TRON链上的USDT。Ledger此前确认在受影响设备中发现了未经授权的硬件植入物，可在设置过程中窃取24词助记词 (Recovery Phrase)，并建议CryptoBilis客户将资产转移至使用新助记词的新设备。

title.en: Tether Freezes $10M USDT Tied to CryptoBilis Ledger Exploit; On-Chain Estimate Rises to ~$102M
title.zh: Tether冻结与CryptoBilis Ledger劫案相关的1,000万美元USDT；链上损失估计升至约1.02亿美元

summary.en: The SEC on October 13 approved a Cboe rule change to list binary options tied to corporate key performance indicators (KPIs). The approval covers 23 large issuers, including Coinbase's trading volume and transaction revenue, MARA's BTC production and energized hashrate, and Robinhood's funded customers and revenues. The contracts are cash-settled and European-style, paying a fixed $1 or nothing at expiry, with settlement based on figures companies report in their earnings filings.
summary.zh: SEC于10月13日批准了Cboe的规则修改，允许上市与上市公司关键绩效指标 (KPI) 挂钩的二元期权 (Binary Option)。首批覆盖23家大型发行人，包括Coinbase的总交易量与交易收入、MARA (Marathon Digital) 的比特币产量与算力、以及Robinhood的客户数与营收数据。这类合约以现金结算 (Cash-settled)、欧式行权，按公司财报披露的数据结算，固定赔付1美元或零。

title.en: SEC Approves Cboe Binary KPI Options Tied to Coinbase Volume and MARA Bitcoin Output
title.zh: SEC批准Cboe上市挂钩Coinbase交易量、MARA比特币产量的二元KPI期权

summary.en: The US Treasury and FDIC issued proposed rulemakings defining licensing, reserve, and custody requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act, with the framework targeted at the law's statutory effective date of January 18, 2027. Separately, the Federal Reserve on October 15 proposed a framework for bank-issued payment stablecoins under the Act, following its earlier state-certification rules. The proposals remain open for public comment.
summary.zh: 美国财政部 (Treasury) 与联邦存款保险公司 (FDIC) 提出了《GENIUS法案》下支付稳定币 (Payment Stablecoin) 的许可、储备与托管规则，发行人需持有联邦或州牌照，规则拟于该法法定生效日2027年1月18日落地。与此同时，美联储于10月15日单独提出了银行发行支付稳定币的框架，延续其此前关于州认证的规则进程。各提案尚处征求意见阶段。

title.en: Treasury and FDIC Advance GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Targeting January 18, 2027; Fed Proposes Bank-Issued Framework
title.zh: 美财政部与FDIC推进GENIUS法案稳定币规则制定，拟2027年1月18日生效；美联储单独提议银行发行框架

summary.en: Turkish media reported that Hex and PulseChain founder Richard Heart (legal name Richard James Schueler) was detained in Istanbul's Beşiktaş district on October 14 in a joint police and intelligence (MIT) operation. Authorities reportedly seized about $4 million in cash and 64 luxury watches from his residence. The detention follows a 2024 Interpol Red Notice requested by Finnish authorities over suspected aggravated tax fraud; his wife was also reportedly taken into custody. The SEC's 2023 civil suit against Heart over $1B+ in token offerings was dismissed by a federal judge in February 2025, and regulators declined to amend — this detention is not a new SEC charge.
summary.zh: 土耳其媒体报道，Hex/PulseChain创始人Richard Heart (法定名Richard James Schueler) 于10月14日在伊斯坦布尔贝西克塔斯区被土耳其警方与国家情报组织 (MIT) 联合拘留，警方在其住所查获约400万美元现金与64块名表；其妻子亦一同被拘留。此次拘留基于国际刑警组织 (Interpol) 2024年应芬兰当局要求发出的红色通缉令，涉加重税务欺诈 (Aggravated Tax Fraud) 嫌疑。值得注意的是，SEC 2023年对其逾10亿美元代币发行案的民事诉讼已于2025年2月被联邦法官驳回且未再起诉——本次并非SEC新的指控。

title.en: Hex Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul Under Interpol Red Notice
title.zh: Hex创始人Richard Heart在伊斯坦布尔被拘留，涉国际刑警红色通缉令

summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded roughly $109.8 million in net inflows on October 13, with Fidelity's Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund accounting for about $103.1 million, reversing the $65.4 million of net outflows seen a day earlier (entirely from BlackRock's IBIT). October remains net negative at around $451 million, signaling fragile institutional demand.
summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 在10月13日录得约1.098亿美元净流入，其中富达 (Fidelity) 的Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund贡献约1.031亿美元，扭转了前一日6540万美元净流出的颓势。不过10月以来累计仍净流出约4.51亿美元，机构需求依然脆弱。

title.en: Bitcoin Spot ETFs See ~$109.8M Inflows on Oct 13, Reversing Prior-Day Outflows
title.zh: 比特币现货ETF (Spot ETF) 10月13日净流入约1.1亿美元，扭转前一日流出态势

summary.en: Blockchain security firm Blockaid flagged an ongoing exploit on UNCX Network's shared token vesting pool on Ethereum on October 14, with roughly $86,000 drained in a single transaction. The affected tokens spanned five projects — EDGEN, ZC, pepeCoin, LO0P and PAAL AI — and Blockaid warned the attack was still running.
summary.zh: 区块链安全公司Blockaid于10月14日披露，UNCX Network在以太坊上的共享代币锁仓池 (Shared Vesting Pool) 遭到持续攻击，攻击者通过单笔交易盗走约8.6万美元代币。被盗代币涉及EDGEN、ZC、pepeCoin、LO0P和PAAL AI五个项目，Blockaid警告攻击仍在进行中。

title.en: UNCX Shared Token Vesting Pool Exploited on Ethereum for ~$86,000
title.zh: UNCX共享代币锁仓池 (Vesting Pool) 在以太坊上遭攻击，被盗约8.6万美元

summary.en: Bitcoin treasury company Strive (NASDAQ: ASST) bought 2,822 BTC for about $235 million at an average price of ~$83,266 between October 12 and 13, lifting total holdings to 35,595 BTC and overtaking MARA as the fourth-largest public bitcoin treasury. The firm also raised roughly $369.2 million from warrant exercises and proposed a 15% Series A perpetual preferred stock offering to fund further purchases.
summary.zh: 比特币财库公司Strive (纳斯达克代码ASST) 在10月12日至13日以约83,266美元均价买入2,822枚比特币，总花费约2.35亿美元，持仓增至35,595枚，超越MARA成为第四大上市比特币财库公司。公司同期通过权证行权获得约3.692亿美元资金，并提议发行15%永续优先股SATS继续加仓。

title.en: Strive Buys Another 2,822 BTC for $235M, Lifting Holdings to 35,595 and Passing MARA
title.zh: Strive再斥资2.35亿美元增持2,822枚比特币 (BTC)，持仓升至35,595枚超越MARA

summary.en: U.S. September headline CPI rose 3.7% year over year and core CPI 2.6%, both above consensus, sending bitcoin below $82,000 while ETH, XRP and SOL fell roughly 3%. Money markets repriced the odds of an October Fed rate hike to 49% from 22%, with higher Treasury yields and a firmer dollar weighing on risk assets.
summary.zh: 美国9月整体CPI同比上涨3.7%、核心CPI同比上涨2.6%，均高于市场预期，比特币在数据公布后一度跌破8.2万美元，ETH、XRP、SOL亦下跌约3%。货币市场已将10月美联储加息概率从22%上调至49%，较高收益率与强美元继续压制风险资产。

title.en: Hotter-Than-Expected September US CPI Sends Bitcoin Below $82,000
title.zh: 美国9月CPI (消费者价格指数) 高于预期，比特币跌破8.2万美元

summary.en: Solana core developer Anza announced the Alpenglow consensus upgrade will activate on mainnet-beta at around 14:50 UTC on October 21, replacing TowerBFT — in use since 2020 — with a new voting protocol called Votor, targeting transaction finality of about 150 milliseconds versus roughly 12.8 seconds today. Validators approved the proposal with 98.27% support, and developers describe it as the largest consensus change in Solana's history.
summary.zh: Solana核心开发公司Anza宣布，Alpenglow共识协议升级将于10月21日约14:50 UTC在主网激活，以新的Votor投票机制取代自2020年沿用的TowerBFT，目标将交易最终确认时间 (Finality) 从约12.8秒缩短至150毫秒。该升级已获验证者以98.27%的高票支持，被视为Solana史上最大共识层变革。

title.en: Solana Schedules Alpenglow Upgrade for Oct 21, Targeting ~150ms Finality
title.zh: Solana定于10月21日激活Alpenglow升级，目标交易最终确认 (Finality) 缩至150毫秒

summary.en: On-chain analytics firm Glassnode said bitcoin has twice bounced from around $81,500 — the estimated aggregate cost basis of U.S. spot ETF investors — despite $681 million in net ETF outflows last week and another $65 million on Monday. If the support eventually breaks, Glassnode points to the True Market Mean near $77,500 as the next major level.
summary.zh: 链上分析公司Glassnode指出，比特币已两次在约8.15万美元的美国现货ETF投资者综合成本基准处获得支撑，尽管同期现货ETF上周净流出6.81亿美元、周一再流出6500万美元。Glassnode称，若该支撑最终失守，约7.75万美元的真实市场均值 (True Market Mean) 将是下一个关键位置。

title.en: Glassnode: Bitcoin Twice Defends $81,500 ETF Cost Basis; $77,500 Next if Lost
title.zh: Glassnode：比特币两次守住8.15万美元ETF成本基准，若失守下一关键位在7.75万美元

summary.en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission made operative a Cboe BZX Exchange rule change on October 13 establishing a standing framework for evaluating options on commodity-based trusts holding multiple crypto assets, waiving the standard 30-day operative delay. Each asset must average at least $700 million in daily market value over the prior 12 months and satisfy surveillance-sharing requirements; the framework authorizes no specific product.
summary.zh: 美国证监会 (SEC) 于10月13日宣布Cboe BZX交易所关于多加密资产商品信托期权的规则变更即刻生效，豁免了常规的30天等待期。新框架要求信托中每种资产过去12个月日均市值不低于7亿美元，且须满足全面信息共享协议 (Surveillance-Sharing Agreement) 条件。该规则仅建立评估框架，并未批准任何具体产品。

title.en: SEC Makes Cboe BZX Framework Operative for Multi-Crypto Options, Waiving 30-Day Delay
title.zh: SEC批准Cboe BZX多加密资产期权框架即刻生效，不再适用30天延迟

summary.en: Interactive Brokers, reporting over $903 billion in client assets, launched Ethereum staking for eligible clients on October 13, with crypto infrastructure provider Zerohash handling the service. Clients stake through a Staking Dashboard in the Client Portal, with rewards credited as additional staked ETH that can compound; Ethereum is the only supported asset at launch.
summary.zh: 管理超9030亿美元客户资产的盈透证券宣布，合格客户可通过其客户门户的质押看板 (Staking Dashboard) 质押以太坊 (Ethereum)，底层质押服务由Zerohash提供，奖励以额外ETH计入并可复利累积。上线初期仅支持ETH，这是传统券商把加密收益功能嵌入多资产平台的又一步。

title.en: Interactive Brokers Launches Ethereum Staking via Zerohash, ETH Only at Launch
title.zh: 盈透证券 (Interactive Brokers) 上线以太坊质押 (Staking) 服务，初期仅支持ETH

summary.en: The SEC proposed a new crypto custody framework on October 1 for registered investment advisers and regulated funds, permitting qualified custodians, state-chartered trust companies, and conditional direct custody when no qualified custodian can support the asset. Direct custody would require written evidence of unavailability and two-person authorization per transaction, with a 60-day comment period.
summary.zh: 美国证监会 (SEC) 于10月1日提议加密资产托管新框架，允许注册投资顾问和受监管基金使用合格托管人、州特许信托公司，并在特定条件下直接托管 (Direct Custody)。直接托管需提供书面证据证明无可用合格托管人，且每笔交易需至少两人授权。新规征求意见期为60天。

title.en: SEC Proposes New Crypto Custody Framework for Funds and State Trusts
title.zh: SEC提议加密资产托管 (Custody) 新规，允许州特许信托公司托管加密资产

summary.en: Bitcoin hardware wallet maker Coldcard confirmed on October 11 that an unauthorized phishing post appeared on its official X account, falsely claiming a firmware flaw and directing users to a copycat site for a "security migration"; the post has been deleted. The company said it found no login or session records matching the post and has contacted X; no financial losses have been verified.
summary.zh: 比特币硬件钱包厂商Coldcard于10月11日确认，其官方X账号出现一条声称固件存在漏洞、诱导用户前往仿冒网站进行“安全迁移”的钓鱼帖文，公司已删除该帖文。Coldcard表示未发现与该帖文匹配的登录或会话记录，已联系X平台调查；截至目前未核实有资金损失。

title.en: Phishing Link Appears on Coldcard's Official X Account; No Matching Login Records Found
title.zh: Coldcard官方X账号惊现钓鱼链接，公司称未发现匹配登录记录

summary.en: Solana completed its staged SIMD-0525 rollout on October 9, cutting target slot time from 400 milliseconds to 200 milliseconds, with the first full epoch averaging 218.3ms per slot. Blocks are now scheduled twice as often, but per-slot compute limits scaled down proportionally, so total throughput did not double; holders need take no action.
summary.zh: Solana于10月9日完成SIMD-0525提案的分阶段升级，目标出块间隔 (Slot Time) 从400毫秒降至200毫秒，首个完整周期实际平均为218.3毫秒。该升级让区块生产机会翻倍，但每槽计算上限同步减半，总吞吐量并未翻倍；持币者无需操作。

title.en: Solana Completes Staged Reduction of Target Slot Time From 400ms to 200ms
title.zh: Solana完成目标出块间隔 (Slot Time) 从400毫秒降至200毫秒的分阶段升级

summary.en: Thailand's SEC crypto ETF framework takes effect October 16, initially allowing only bitcoin and ether. Funds must maintain average net exposure of at least 80% of NAV per accounting year, use licensed custodians and trade exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand; securities firms are barred from offering margin loans for the purchases.
summary.zh: 泰国证监会 (SEC) 发布的加密ETF框架将于10月16日生效，首期仅允许比特币 (BTC) 和以太坊 (ETH)，基金须保持年均净敞口不低于净资产80%，并使用持牌托管人、在泰国证券交易所 (SET) 交易。证券公司被禁止提供融资买入此类ETF。

title.en: Thailand SEC Crypto ETF Rules Take Effect Oct 16, Limited to Bitcoin and Ether Initially
title.zh: 泰国证监会加密ETF新规10月16日生效，首期仅允许比特币和以太坊

summary.en: Ethereum's next major upgrade, Glamsterdam, activated as scheduled on the Sepolia public testnet on October 6, bundling 18 EIPs headlined by enshrined proposer-builder separation (EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (EIP-7928), with the testnet gas limit trialed near 200 million versus mainnet's 60 million. Next is the Hoodi testnet in late October, with a mainnet target in Q4 2026.
summary.zh: 以太坊下一次重大升级Glamsterdam于10月6日在Sepolia公共测试网按计划激活，包含18项EIP，核心是内嵌的提议者-构建者分离 (ePBS, EIP-7732) 与区块级访问列表 (Block-Level Access Lists, EIP-7928)，目标区块Gas上限测试至约2亿（主网现为6000万）。下一步是10月下旬的Hoodi测试网，主网目标仍为2026年第四季度。

title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Activates on Sepolia Testnet With 18 EIPs
title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级在Sepolia测试网激活，包含18项EIP
比特币在CPI公布前于8.34万美元附近盘整，市场屏息等待9月通胀数据
title.en: Bitcoin Consolidates Near $83,400 Ahead of Today's September CPI Print

summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin) 在10月14日美国9月CPI (消费者价格指数) 公布前进入观望模式，价格在约8.34万至8.38万美元之间横盘。9月16日美联储 (Federal Reserve) 已加息至3.75%-4%区间，若通胀高于预期，可能强化12月再加息的预期并打压风险资产。
summary.en: Bitcoin held a pre-release holding pattern near $83,400-$83,800 ahead of the September US CPI print due at 8:30 a.m. ET on October 14. With the Fed already back in a hiking cycle at 3.75%-4%, a hotter-than-expected print could strengthen expectations of another hike and weigh on risk assets, while a soft print would ease rate fears.

title.zh: Ledger披露CryptoBilis植入细节：通过eSIM和蜂窝网络窃取24词助记词
title.en: Ledger Details LTE Implants That Copied 24-Word Recovery Phrases via Cellular Networks

summary.zh: Ledger安全团队 (Ledger Donjon) 披露，CryptoBilis渠道售出的设备中的恶意植入体会在设置时截取屏幕显示的24词助记词 (recovery phrase)，通过内置eSIM (嵌入式SIM卡) 经由LTE网络传出。公司强调植入体未破坏安全芯片，也未篡改交易，并正在核查CryptoBilis之外的报告。
summary.en: Ledger's security team (Ledger Donjon) disclosed that malicious implants in devices sold via CryptoBilis captured the 24-word recovery phrase shown during setup and transmitted it over LTE networks using an embedded eSIM. The company stressed the implant did not compromise the secure chip or alter transactions, and said it is examining reports beyond the CryptoBilis reseller.

title.zh: ENS创始人向DAO提交ENSv2主网激活提案，新.eth注册将暂停数小时
title.en: ENS Founder Submits ENSv2 Mainnet Activation Proposal to DAO; New .eth Registrations Would Pause

summary.zh: 以太坊域名服务 (Ethereum Name Service, ENS) 创始人Nick Johnson向ENS DAO提交可执行提案，请求激活ENSv2命名系统主网。提案要求冻结旧注册器的新注册，现有域名持有人可继续续费无需迁移；通过需要100万票的多数支持及7天链上投票 (onchain vote)。
summary.en: Ethereum Name Service (ENS) founder Nick Johnson submitted an executable draft proposal to the ENS DAO seeking to activate the ENSv2 naming system on mainnet. The proposal would freeze new registrations on the original registrar while existing holders keep their names without migrating; passage requires a majority of at least 1 million ENS votes over a seven-day onchain vote.

title.zh: Autheo的THEO代币疑遭跨链桥攻击，24小时暴跌92%
title.en: Autheo's THEO Token Plunges 92% After Suspected Cross-Chain Bridge Exploit

summary.zh: Autheo团队证实正调查一起涉及THEO代币的安全事件，并警告持币者在调查结束前不要买卖或跨链桥接 (bridge) THEO。区块链安全公司PeckShield报告攻击者在Base链上未经授权铸造约1900万THEO并兑换为约700.8 ETH (约176万美元)；另一位研究者称铸造量可能高达1.19亿枚。
summary.en: The Autheo team confirmed it is investigating a security incident involving the THEO token and warned holders not to buy, sell, or bridge THEO until its investigation concludes. Blockchain security firm PeckShield reported the attacker minted about 19 million THEO on Base without authorization and swapped them for roughly 700.8 ETH (about $1.76 million); another researcher claimed unauthorized minting could be as high as 119 million tokens.

title.zh: Pando Finance香港第二只SOL现货ETF今日上市，管理费0.6%
title.en: Pando Finance Lists Hong Kong's Second Spot Solana ETF Today With 0.6% Management Fee

summary.zh: Pando Finance的SOL现货ETF (代码02831) 今日在香港交易所 (Hong Kong Stock Exchange) 上市，成为继华夏 (ChinaAMC) 之后香港第二只直接持有SOL的产品。基金年管理费0.6%、预计经常性开支1.6%，通过HashKey交易与托管，且不进行质押 (staking)、不使用衍生品。
summary.en: Pando Finance's spot Solana ETF (ticker 02831) listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange today, becoming Hong Kong's second fund directly holding SOL after ChinaAMC's product. The fund charges a 0.6% annual management fee with an estimated 1.6% ongoing expense ratio, uses HashKey Exchange for trading and HashKey Custody for safekeeping, and will not stake its SOL or use derivatives.

title.zh: Strategy上周再增持250枚比特币，总持仓达84.8万枚
title.en: Strategy Adds Another 250 Bitcoin, Holdings Reach 848,250 BTC

summary.zh: Strategy (前MicroStrategy) 在10月5日至11日期间以约2150万美元购入250枚比特币 (Bitcoin)，均价约8.62万美元，总持仓达到84.825万枚。公司同日财报显示同期回购了约1.92亿美元优先股 (preferred shares)，投入回购的资金约为购币资金的九倍。
summary.en: Strategy bought 250 BTC between October 5 and 11 for about $21.5 million at an average price of roughly $86,194, bringing total holdings to 848,250 BTC. The same filing showed about $192.4 million of preferred-share repurchases in the same window — roughly nine times what the company spent on Bitcoin.

title.zh: 周一美现货比特币ETF净流出6540万美元，10月累计流出4.52亿美元
title.en: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs Lose $65.4M on Monday; October Now at a $452M Deficit

summary.zh: 10月12日美国现货比特币 (Spot Bitcoin) ETF单日净流出6540万美元，全部来自贝莱德 (BlackRock) 的IBIT，其余11只产品无资金变动。以太坊 (Ether) ETF同日净流出8540万美元；10月至今美比特币ETF累计净流出约4.52亿美元，抹去了月初连续四个交易日的流入。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $65.4 million in net outflows on Monday, October 12 — all of it from BlackRock's IBIT, with the other 11 funds reporting no flow — while spot Ether ETFs shed $85.4 million. October's net Bitcoin ETF flow now stands at about negative $452 million, wiping out the inflows from the month's first four sessions.

title.zh: 法国财委会支持稳定币兑换税与加密离境税，随后否决预算案
title.en: French Finance Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget

summary.zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会通过两项加密税修正案：自2027年1月1日起将加密货币兑换为MiCA定义的稳定币视为应税出售，并将离境税 (exit tax) 扩展至加密资产（持仓超80万欧元且移居国外者）。但委员会随后否决了2027年预算的收入部分，两项措施须在10月13日开始的全会辩论中重新提出。
summary.en: France's National Assembly finance committee adopted two crypto tax amendments: treating crypto-to-stablecoin swaps (MiCA-defined electronic money tokens) as taxable sales from January 1, 2027, and extending the exit tax to crypto holdings above €800,000 for those moving tax residence abroad. The committee then rejected the revenue section of the 2027 budget, so both measures must be reintroduced when the full chamber debates the budget from October 13.

title.zh: "加密妈妈"Hester Peirce卸任SEC委员，委员会仅剩两名委员
title.en: 'Crypto Mom' Hester Peirce Leaves SEC; Commission Down to Two Sitting Members

summary.zh: 被称为"加密妈妈"的SEC (美国证券交易委员会) 委员Hester Peirce于10月2日正式卸任，结束其近九年任期；她曾领导SEC加密工作组 (Crypto Task Force)。她的离开使委员会仅剩主席Paul Atkins和委员Mark Uyeda两名在任委员，三个席位空缺待总统提名与参议院确认。
summary.en: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, nicknamed 'Crypto Mom,' officially stepped down on October 2, ending a nearly nine-year tenure that included leading the SEC's Crypto Task Force. Her departure leaves the commission with only two sitting members — Chairman Paul Atkins and Commissioner Mark Uyeda — with three seats vacant pending presidential nomination and Senate confirmation.

title.zh: Ledger经销商供应链攻击：约9300万美元被盗，确认硬件植入，Tether冻结1000万美元
title.en: Ledger Reseller Supply-Chain Attack: ~$93M Stolen, Hardware Implant Confirmed, Tether Freezes $10M

summary.zh: 法国硬件钱包厂商Ledger确认，从马来西亚经销商CryptoBilis购入的设备中发现未授权硬件植入（hardware implant）。区块链分析公司Bitquery追踪到约9300万美元加密资产从315个钱包被盗（另有估计称9400万至9450万美元），Tether已冻结其中约1000万美元USDT (Tether)。
summary.en: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in devices bought from Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery traced about $93.2 million stolen from 315 wallets (other estimates put losses at $94-94.5 million), and Tether has frozen $10 million in USDT linked to the theft.

title.zh: 比特币与以太坊现货ETF单周合计净流出12.2亿美元，比特币结束三周流入
title.en: Spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs Record Combined $1.2B Weekly Outflows; Bitcoin Ends Three-Week Inflow Streak

summary.zh: 10月5日至9日，美国现货比特币 (Spot Bitcoin) ETF净流出6.81亿美元，以太坊 (Ethereum) ETF净流出5.42亿美元，合计约12.2亿美元。其中贝莱德 (BlackRock) 的ETHA占以太坊ETF流出的4.77亿美元，两只产品均告别此前的连续净流入。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $681 million in net outflows and spot Ether ETFs $542 million during October 5-9, a combined $1.2 billion. BlackRock's ETHA accounted for $477 million of the Ether withdrawals, ending weeks of consecutive inflows for both products.

title.zh: 比特币重返84,000美元上方，做空平仓助推反弹；小市值代币领涨
title.en: Bitcoin Back Above $84,000 on Short Covering; Small-Cap Tokens Lead the Rally

summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin) 周一回升至84,000美元上方，24小时涨约1.3%，反弹主要来自空头平仓和期货做多力量回补。此轮涨幅由流动性较薄的小市值代币引领（CoinDesk 80指数涨约3%），以太坊回升至2,560美元附近，市场静待周三美国9月CPI数据。
summary.en: Bitcoin climbed back above $84,000 on Monday, up about 1.3% in 24 hours as heavy short liquidations forced bearish traders to cover. Gains were led by thinly traded small-cap tokens (the CoinDesk 80 index rose ~3%), while Ether recovered toward $2,560 ahead of Wednesday's U.S. September CPI release.

title.zh: Solana现货ETF单周净流出2480万美元，终结连续14周流入
title.en: Solana Spot ETFs Post $24.8M Weekly Outflows, Ending 14-Week Inflow Streak

summary.zh: 美国Solana现货ETF在10月5日至9日当周净流出2480万美元，连续五日出现赎回，终结了长达14周的净流入纪录。产品总资产从19亿美元降至约17.3亿美元，Solana在代币化股票交易量中仍占约65%份额。
summary.en: U.S. spot Solana ETFs recorded $24.8 million in net outflows during October 5-9, five straight days of withdrawals that ended a 14-week inflow streak. Total net assets fell from $1.90 billion to about $1.73 billion, while Solana retained roughly a 65% share of tokenized-equities trading volume.

title.zh: 美SEC提议加密托管新规：允许有条件自托管，州信托公司可作合格托管人
title.en: SEC Proposes Crypto Custody Rules: Conditional Self-Custody, State Trust Companies as Qualified Custodians

summary.zh: 美国证监会 (SEC) 于10月1日提议的数字资产托管框架允许注册投资顾问在特定条件下自持客户加密资产的私钥，并将州特许信托公司纳入合格托管人 (qualified custodian) 名单。该提案已于10月6日发布于《联邦公报》(Federal Register)，公众意见征询期至12月7日。
summary.en: The SEC's October 1 custody proposal would let registered investment advisers hold client crypto private keys themselves under limited conditions and add state-chartered trust companies to the list of qualified custodians. Published in the Federal Register on October 6, the proposal is open for public comment through December 7.

title.zh: Coldcard官方X账号惊现钓鱼链接，公司称未发现异常登录记录
title.en: Coldcard's Official X Account Publishes Phishing Link; No Unauthorized Login Found

summary.zh: 比特币硬件钱包厂商Coldcard (Coinkite) 表示，其官方X账号10月11日出现一条冒充固件漏洞警告的钓鱼帖，诱导用户前往仿冒网站进行“安全迁移”，帖子已被删除。公司称账户启用离线双因素认证 (2FA)，内部审查未发现异常登录，已要求X平台协助调查；暂未确认用户资金损失。
summary.en: Bitcoin hardware wallet maker Coldcard said a phishing post appeared on its official X account on October 11, posing as an urgent firmware flaw warning and directing users to a copycat site for a "security migration"; the post has been deleted. The firm found no unauthorized login records, credits offline 2FA, and has asked X to investigate; no verified user losses so far.

title.zh: Solana完成200毫秒出块间隔升级，较8月翻倍出块频率
title.en: Solana Completes 200-Millisecond Slot Upgrade, Doubling Block Frequency Since August

summary.zh: Solana于10月9日在主网epoch 1053激活200毫秒目标出块间隔 (slot time)，较原先的400毫秒减半，完成了自8月21日以来的四阶段降速（400→350→300→250→200毫秒）。该升级为网络层面变更（SIMD-0525），并非Alpenglow共识升级；区块更小更频繁，网络每秒理论处理能力大致不变。
summary.en: Solana activated a 200-millisecond target slot time on mainnet at epoch 1053 on October 9, halving its original 400ms setting and completing a four-stage reduction since August 21 (400→350→300→250→200ms). The network-level change (SIMD-0525) is distinct from the Alpenglow consensus upgrade; blocks are smaller but more frequent, leaving theoretical per-second capacity roughly unchanged.

title.zh: 美SEC批准首批3倍杠杆比特币与以太坊ETF上市规则，仍需注册生效后才能交易
title.en: SEC Approves First 3x Bitcoin and Ether ETF Listing Rule; Trading Still Needs Effective Registration

summary.zh: 美SEC于10月2日批准Cboe BZX交易所规则变更，允许Volatility Shares旗下六只3倍杠杆产品上市，含3倍比特币ETF与3倍以太坊ETF，是美国历史上首次突破2倍杠杆上限的加密杠杆产品。该批准仅是上市规则许可，产品仍需注册声明生效后方可交易；六只产品均将通过受监管的期货合约 (futures) 实现杠杆，而非直接持有现货。
summary.en: The SEC on October 2 approved a Cboe BZX rule change allowing six 3x leveraged products from Volatility Shares to list, including 3x Bitcoin and 3x Ether ETFs — the first U.S. crypto products to break the 2x leverage ceiling. The order only permits listing; trading still requires an effective registration statement. All six will use regulated futures, not spot holdings, for leverage.

title.zh: 泰国SEC批准本土比特币与以太坊ETF，10月16日生效
title.en: Thailand's SEC Approves Locally Listed Bitcoin and Ether ETFs, Effective October 16

summary.zh: 泰国证监会 (SEC) 于10月8日发布11份通知，允许本土资管公司在泰国证券交易所 (SET) 发行比特币与以太坊ETF，10月16日起生效。规则要求基金每个会计年度对单一加密资产的平均净敞口不低于资产净值 (NAV) 的80%，资产须交由泰国SEC监管的本土托管人保管；散户暂不能通过存托凭证 (DR) 等间接购买海外加密ETF。
summary.en: Thailand's SEC on October 8 issued 11 notifications allowing local asset managers to launch Bitcoin and Ether ETFs on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, effective October 16. Funds must keep average net exposure to a single crypto asset at no less than 80% of NAV each accounting year and use SEC-regulated local custodians; retail investors remain barred from indirect access to foreign crypto ETFs via instruments like depositary receipts.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级在Sepolia测试网激活，主网时间待定
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Activates on Sepolia Testnet; Mainnet Date Undecided

summary.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级于10月6日在Sepolia测试网 (Sepolia testnet) 按期激活，这是主网上线前的关键一步。升级核心包括协议内生的提议者-构建者分离 (enshrined proposer-builder separation, ePBS) 与区块级访问列表 (block-level access lists, BALs)，目标是大幅提升一层 (L1) 吞吐量；以太坊基金会称主网日期尚未确定。
summary.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6 as scheduled, a key step before mainnet. Headline changes include enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS) and block-level access lists (BALs), targeting much higher Layer 1 throughput; the Ethereum Foundation says the mainnet date is not yet decided.

title.zh: Solana生态10月迎来多起大额代币解锁，DoubleZero领衔释放约1.13亿美元
title.en: Solana Ecosystem Faces Large October Token Unlocks; DoubleZero Leads With ~$113M

summary.zh: 10月Solana生态多个项目释放大批锁定代币：DoubleZero (2Z) 10月2日起解锁17.8亿枚（约1.13亿美元），占流通量约34.8%，其12个月归属悬崖到期；Official Trump (TRUMP) 解锁约2802万枚（约6080万美元）；Pump.fun (PUMP) 按月线性释放70亿枚（约4025万美元）；deBridge (DBR) 将于10月17日解锁约6.18亿枚。反观Sanctum (SANC) 10月6日通过治理投票销毁25%供应。
summary.en: Several Solana projects unlock large token batches in October: DoubleZero ($2Z) begins unlocking 1.78 billion tokens (~$113M) on October 2, about 34.8% of circulating supply, as its 12-month vesting cliff expires; Official Trump ($TRUMP) releases ~28.02M tokens (~$60.8M); Pump.fun ($PUMP) linearly vests 7B tokens (~$40.25M); deBridge ($DBR) unlocks ~618.33M on October 17. In the opposite direction, Sanctum ($SANC) burned 25% of its supply on October 6 after a governance vote.

title.zh: EIP-8363从以太坊Hegotá升级中撤回，发行政策辩论移交独立流程
title.en: EIP-8363 Withdrawn From Ethereum's Hegotá Upgrade; Issuance Debate Moves to Separate Process

summary.zh: 拟按质押比例销毁验证者奖励的EIP-8363（Tapered Issuance Burn）提案作者于10月1日宣布，从以太坊下下代升级Hegotá的备选中撤回该提案，称分叉选型流程不适合裁决发行政策这类根本性变革。作者将转入专门的多节点治理流程，首场发行政策论坛定于11月Devcon举行。
summary.en: The authors of EIP-8363 (Tapered Issuance Burn), which would burn a rising share of validator rewards as staking grows, withdrew the proposal from consideration for Ethereum's Hegotá upgrade on October 1, saying a fork-scoping process is not the right venue for issuance policy. They will pursue a dedicated governance process, starting with an issuance forum at Devcon in November.

title.zh: 加密市场迎关键一周：比特币守83,000美元、以太坊约2,500美元，周三CPI成焦点
title.en: Crypto Enters a Key Week: Bitcoin Near $83,000, Ether Near $2,500, Wednesday CPI in Focus

summary.zh: 加密市场以比特币 (Bitcoin) 约83,000美元、以太坊 (Ethereum) 约2,500美元开启10月12日至18日的一周。美国9月消费者价格指数 (CPI) 定于周三10月14日公布，市场预期总体通胀率约3.7%；同周还有Aptos与Arbitrum代币解锁 (token unlock) 以及周五约12.5亿美元的期权到期 (options expiry)。
summary.en: Crypto markets enter the week of October 12-18 with Bitcoin near $83,000 and Ethereum near $2,500. U.S. September CPI data arrives Wednesday, October 14, with headline inflation expected near 3.7%; the calendar also includes Aptos and Arbitrum token unlocks and a Friday options expiry of about $1.25 billion.

title.zh: 比特币现货ETF录得6月底以来最差一周：净流出约6.81亿美元
title.en: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Post Worst Week Since Late June With About $681M in Net Outflows

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 在截至10月9日的一周净流出约6.81亿美元，为6月底以来最差单周表现，周五单日转为净流入2,110万美元，其中贝莱德IBIT贡献约2,240万美元。多家报道指出，机构需求 (institutional demand) 明显降温，比特币周末在81,300至85,200美元的窄幅区间内交投。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded about $681 million in net outflows in the week to October 9, their worst week since late June, before returning to a $21.1 million inflow on Friday, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for about $22.4 million. Reports point to cooled institutional demand, while Bitcoin traded over the weekend inside a narrow $81,300-$85,200 range.

title.zh: Solana完成出块时间减半：200毫秒槽位在主网epoch 1053生效
title.en: Solana Completes Block-Time Halving: 200-Millisecond Slots Live at Epoch 1053

summary.zh: Solana已完成SIMD-0525分阶段升级，目标槽位时间 (slot time) 从最初的400毫秒降至200毫秒，最终一步于10月9日在epoch 1053生效，每秒可提供5次出块机会。每个区块的计算上限 (compute units) 同步降至3,000万单位，因此网络总处理能力大致不变；验证者投票与网络压力则相应上升。
summary.en: Solana has completed its staged SIMD-0525 upgrade, cutting target slot time from the original 400 milliseconds to 200 milliseconds, with the final step taking effect at epoch 1053 on October 9 and allowing five block-production opportunities per second. Each block's compute limit falls to 30 million compute units, keeping overall processing capacity roughly unchanged while validator voting demands rise.

title.zh: 本周代币解锁日历：Aptos释放1,131万枚APT，Arbitrum将于10月16日解锁
title.en: This Week's Token Unlock Calendar: Aptos Releases 11.31M APT, Arbitrum Unlock Due October 16

summary.zh: Aptos于10月11日释放1,131万枚APT (token unlock)，估值约906万美元，分配给核心贡献者、社区、投资者与基金会。Arbitrum定于10月16日解锁约9,270万枚ARB，估值约1,990万美元；供应释放与周五的期权到期叠加，成为本周需要关注的流动性 (liquidity) 事件。
summary.en: Aptos released 11.31 million APT on October 11, valued at about $9.06 million, allocated to core contributors, the community, investors and the foundation. Arbitrum is scheduled to unlock about 92.7 million ARB on October 16, valued at roughly $19.9 million; together with Friday's options expiry, the supply events are key liquidity items on this week's calendar.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级在Sepolia运行，区块gas上限测试近2亿
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Runs on Sepolia, Testing a Near-200M Gas Limit

summary.zh: 以太坊下一次硬分叉Glamsterdam已于10月6日在Sepolia测试网 (testnet) 激活，引入协议内提议者-构建者分离 (ePBS, EIP-7732) 与区块级访问列表 (block-level access lists, EIP-7928)，以支持并行处理。Sepolia区块的gas上限 (gas limit) 已升至近2亿，约为此前6,000万的三倍多；Hoodi测试网与主网日期尚未确定。
summary.en: Ethereum's next hard fork, Glamsterdam, activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, introducing enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS, EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (EIP-7928) to support parallel processing. Sepolia blocks are running with a gas limit near 200 million, more than three times the previous roughly 60 million; dates for the Hoodi testnet and mainnet remain undecided.

title.zh: Coldcard官方X账号被盗用发布钓鱼帖，假称Mk4、Mk5与Q存在固件漏洞
title.en: Coldcard's Official X Account Used for Phishing Post Falsely Claiming Firmware Flaw in Mk4, Mk5 and Q

summary.zh: 比特币硬件钱包厂商Coldcard的官方X账号于10月11日约02:00 UTC发布一条钓鱼帖 (phishing)，假称Mk4、Mk5与Q设备存在严重固件漏洞，诱导用户通过虚假迁移页面转移资产，该帖随后被删除。公司表示其内部审查未发现异常登录记录，已联系X展开调查，并提醒用户其唯一官网为coldcard.com；目前尚无经证实的用户损失报告。
summary.en: A phishing post appeared on Bitcoin hardware-wallet maker Coldcard's official X account around 02:00 UTC on October 11, falsely claiming a critical firmware vulnerability in the Mk4, Mk5 and Q devices and urging users to move funds through a fake migration page; the post was later deleted. The company said an internal review found no matching login records, that it has contacted X for an investigation, and that coldcard.com is its only official website; no verified user losses have been reported.

title.zh: Ledger确认一台受影响设备含未授权硬件植入，CryptoBilis停售全部硬件钱包
title.en: Ledger Confirms Unauthorized Hardware Implant in One Affected Device; CryptoBilis Halts All Hardware Wallet Sales

summary.zh: Ledger于10月10日确认，在CryptoBilis调查中，一名受影响用户的设备内发现未授权硬件植入 (hardware implant)，这是公司首次证实物理篡改 (physical tampering)。链上分析公司Bitquery估计311个钱包损失约9,290万美元，调查者Specter的估计超过8,600万美元，但Ledger尚未证实任何数字；CryptoBilis已停售全部硬件钱包。
summary.en: Ledger confirmed on October 10 that a device belonging to one affected user in the CryptoBilis investigation contained an unauthorized hardware implant, its first confirmation of physical tampering. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery estimated about $92.9 million lost across 311 wallets and investigator Specter put losses above $86 million, but Ledger has not verified any figure; CryptoBilis has halted sales of all hardware wallets.

title.zh: 现货以太坊ETF连续第九日净流出：10月9日流出5,610万美元，全部来自贝莱德ETHA
title.en: Spot Ether ETFs See Ninth Straight Outflow Day: $56.1M Leaves on October 9, All From BlackRock's ETHA

summary.zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 于10月9日净流出5,610万美元，连续第九个交易日流出，且当日流出全部来自贝莱德的ETHA。自9月29日以来累计流出约6.97亿美元，基金总资产降至约157.1亿美元；ETH同期交投于2,496美元附近。
summary.en: U.S. spot Ether ETFs posted $56.1 million in net outflows on October 9, a ninth straight day of withdrawals, with the entire amount coming from BlackRock's ETHA. Cumulative outflows since September 29 total about $697 million and total fund assets have fallen to roughly $15.71 billion, while ETH traded near $2,496.

title.zh: Santiment：Solana网络增长自9月初以来跃升124%，日增约171万个新钱包
title.en: Santiment: Solana Network Growth Up 124% Since Early September, About 1.71M New Wallets a Day

summary.zh: 链上分析公司Santiment数据显示，Solana网络增长 (network growth) 自9月初以来跃升124%，每日新建钱包约171万个；日活跃地址 (daily active addresses) 同期上升58%，达到约427万个。网络上持有稳定币的地址数也在10月7日突破1,400万；分析同时提醒，地址增长不等同于真实新增用户。
summary.en: On-chain analytics firm Santiment reports Solana network growth has jumped 124% since early September, with about 1.71 million new wallets created daily. Daily active addresses rose 58% over the same period to roughly 4.27 million, and addresses holding stablecoins on the network passed 14 million on October 7; analysts caution that address growth does not equal the same number of new human users.

title.zh: OKX获Circle、Ripple等战略投资，OKXICE代币化美股场所成SEC豁免框架早期测试
title.en: OKX Draws Strategic Investment From Circle and Ripple as OKXICE Tokenized-Stock Venue Tests SEC Exemption

summary.zh: OKX披露获得Circle、Ripple、QRT与渣打银行旗下SC Ventures的战略投资 (strategic investment)，此前ICE已入股。其与ICE的合资企业OKXICE计划在SEC创新豁免 (Innovation Exemption) 下推出代币化美股 (tokenized stocks) 场所，覆盖63家美国公司、在X Layer上以USDC、USDT、USDG结算，代币保留分红与投票权；分析师认为机构采用程度仍待观察。
summary.en: OKX disclosed strategic investments from Circle, Ripple, QRT and Standard Chartered's SC Ventures, following an earlier investment by ICE. Its OKXICE joint venture with ICE plans a tokenized-stock venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption covering 63 U.S. companies, settling in USDC, USDT and USDG on X Layer with tokens retaining dividend and voting rights; analysts say the scale of institutional adoption remains to be seen.

title.zh: 贝森特：美国本周可能再扣押约10亿美元与伊朗关联的加密货币
title.en: Bessent: U.S. May Seize Another $1B in Iran-Linked Crypto This Week

summary.zh: 美国财政部长Scott Bessent在华盛顿Newsmax政策峰会上表示，美国本周可能再扣押约10亿美元与伊朗关联的加密货币，并称当局已掌握资金位置，正推进所谓绝对孤立 (absolute isolation) 行动。他未说明涉及的具体资产或钱包；此前Tether已在2026年配合制裁执法冻结约5.5亿美元USDT。
summary.en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told the Newsmax Policy Summit in Washington that the United States may seize about another $1 billion in Iran-linked cryptocurrency this week, saying authorities know where the funds are as part of an 'absolute isolation' campaign. He did not specify the assets or wallets involved; Tether has previously frozen about $550 million in USDT during 2026 as part of sanctions enforcement.

title.zh: FinCEN撤回两项加密拟议规则：自托管钱包报告与混币特别措施均终止
title.en: FinCEN Withdraws Two Proposed Crypto Rules: Unhosted-Wallet Reporting and Mixer Special Measure

summary.zh: 美国金融犯罪执法局 (FinCEN) 于10月5日宣布、10月6日在《联邦公报》刊登，正式撤回两项拟议规则：2020年的非托管钱包 (unhosted wallet) 交易报告要求，以及2023年将国际加密混币 (CVC mixing) 列为主要洗钱关切的特别措施。FinCEN援引公众意见称，两项提案可能对合法活动产生寒蝉效应 (chilling effect) 并带来沉重报告负担；现有《银行保密法》义务不变。
summary.en: The U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) announced on October 5, with Federal Register publication on October 6, the withdrawal of two proposed rules: the 2020 unhosted-wallet transaction reporting requirements and the 2023 special measure treating international CVC mixing as a primary money-laundering concern. FinCEN cited public comments that the proposals could chill legitimate activity and impose heavy reporting burdens; existing Bank Secrecy Act obligations remain unchanged.

Bitcoin held steady near $83,000 over the weekend after rebounding more than 2% on Friday from Thursday's lows around $80,000. CoinDesk reported BTC climbing back above $83,000, while CoinPulseHQ's daily market roundup showed Worldcoin as the day's top mover with an 11% jump. Sentiment remains tied to Treasury yields and oil prices.
summary.zh: 比特币在周末持稳于83,000美元附近，此前周五反弹逾2%，从周四80,000美元左右的低点回升。CoinDesk报道称比特币已重新站上83,000美元上方，而CoinPulseHQ的市场日报显示当日涨幅居前的是Worldcoin，大涨约11%。市场情绪仍受美债收益率与油价走势牵动。

title.en: Bitcoin Steady Near $83,000 Over the Weekend as Worldcoin Jumps 11%
title.zh: 比特币周末持稳于83,000美元附近，Worldcoin领涨11%

summary.en: Token Terminal data published by Solana Hub on October 10 shows Solana's on-chain applications earned $38.2 million in seven days, more than three times Ethereum's $11.7 million, topping the ranking with Hyperliquid second at $14.8 million. Low fees and high throughput keep drawing trading apps to Solana at scale.
summary.zh: Token Terminal数据显示，Solana链上应用 (dApp) 过去7天收入达3,820万美元，约为以太坊（1,170万美元）的三倍以上，在Solana Hub于10月10日发布的榜单中居首，Hyperliquid以1,480万美元居第二。低手续费与高吞吐持续吸引交易类应用在Solana上大规模部署。

title.en: Solana dApp Revenue Hits $38.2M in Seven Days, More Than 3x Ethereum
title.zh: Solana应用收入7天达3,820万美元，为以太坊三倍多

summary.en: THORChain technical co-founder Chad Barraford said Tether blacklisted four of the protocol's Tron vault addresses on October 9 without prior notice, freezing about 1.45 million USDT and halting Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations for roughly three hours before reversing the action. The incident renewed debate over centralized stablecoin issuers' control of DeFi assets.
summary.zh: THORChain技术联合创始人Chad Barraford称，Tether于10月9日在无事先沟通的情况下，将THORChain四个TRON金库地址列入黑名单 (blacklist)，冻结约145万枚USDT，导致该链跨链兑换与流动性提供功能中断约三小时，随后全部解封。此事再次引发关于中心化稳定币发行方对DeFi协议资产控制权的讨论。

title.en: Tether Briefly Freezes About $1.45M USDT in THORChain Tron Vaults, Then Reverses
title.zh: Tether临时冻结THORChain四个TRON金库约145万美元USDT，三小时后解封

summary.en: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission finalized 11 notifications allowing local asset managers to launch Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, effective October 16. Initially only BTC and ETH are eligible; each ETF must hold at least 80% of net asset value in a single cryptocurrency with SEC-regulated custodians, while Thai retail investors will be barred from foreign crypto ETFs.
summary.zh: 泰国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 批准了11项新规，允许本地资产管理公司在泰国证券交易所 (SET) 发行比特币与以太坊ETF，规则自10月16日起生效。初期仅比特币和以太坊可作为底层资产，每只ETF须将至少80%的净资产配置于单一加密货币，并由受SEC监管的托管机构保管；泰国散户将不得购买海外加密ETF。

title.en: Thailand Approves Local Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs, Framework Effective October 16
title.zh: 泰国批准本土比特币与以太坊ETF，规则10月16日生效

summary.en: The U.S. Department of Justice announced that Empire Market co-creator Raheim Hamilton was sentenced to 40 years in federal prison and fined $5 million; as part of his plea, he agreed to forfeit about 1,230 Bitcoin (worth roughly $101 million) and 24.4 Ether. The dark-web market processed over 4 million transactions worth more than $430 million between 2018 and 2020, including nearly $375 million in drug sales.
summary.zh: 美国司法部宣布，暗网市场Empire Market的联合创建者Raheim Hamilton被判处40年联邦监禁并罚款500万美元；作为认罪协议的一部分，他同意没收约1,230枚比特币（价值约1.01亿美元）及24.4枚以太坊。该市场2018年至2020年间促成超过400万笔交易，总额逾4.3亿美元，其中毒品销售额近3.75亿美元。

title.en: Empire Market Co-Founder Sentenced to 40 Years, Forfeits 1,230 Bitcoin
title.zh: 暗网市场Empire Market联合创始人被判40年监禁，没收1,230枚比特币

summary.en: The European Securities and Markets Authority published a call for evidence asking banks, clearinghouses and custodians to show that central counterparties can access, transfer and quickly liquidate tokenized collateral under stress, including a clearing-member default. Responses are due January 15, 2027, and ESMA will assess in Q1 2027 whether further regulatory action is needed.
summary.zh: 欧洲证券与市场管理局 (ESMA) 发布征求证据文件 (call for evidence)，要求银行、清算所和托管机构证明：在清算会员违约等压力情景下，中央对手方 (CCP) 能否获取、转移代币化抵押品并迅速将其变现。反馈截止2027年1月15日，ESMA将于2027年第一季度评估是否需要进一步监管行动。

title.en: ESMA Opens Call for Evidence on Tokenized Collateral, Testing Crisis Liquidity
title.zh: ESMA就代币化抵押品公开征求证据，评估危机中的可变现性

summary.en: El Salvador added 7 BTC over the past week, lifting its national Bitcoin reserve to 7,798 coins worth more than $643 million. Notably, the IMF just approved a $138 million disbursement and granted a waiver for the country's earlier breach of Bitcoin-accumulation limits; the Fund determined additions since June 2025 came from private donations rather than public funds.
summary.zh: 萨尔瓦多政府继续增持比特币，过去7天新增7枚，国家比特币储备达到7,798枚，价值逾6.43亿美元。值得注意的是，IMF刚刚批准向萨尔瓦多拨付1.38亿美元贷款，并就此前政府增持比特币违反贷款条款给予豁免 (waiver)；IMF认定2025年6月之后的新增部分来自私人捐赠而非公共资金。

title.en: El Salvador Adds 7 BTC, National Reserve Hits 7,798 Coins
title.zh: 萨尔瓦多一周增持7枚比特币，国家储备达7,798枚

summary.en: Moscow Exchange senior managing director Boris Blokhin confirmed the bourse plans to launch crypto trading on December 1 under Russia's new digital-asset legislation, with testing underway alongside professional traders. The initial lineup is Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP and Tron; the Bank of Russia has begun registering crypto exchange operators and custodians, and Sberbank plans its own crypto products the same day.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯最大证券交易所莫斯科交易所 (MOEX) 高管Boris Blokhin确认，计划依据9月1日生效的加密货币市场立法，于12月1日推出加密货币交易服务，目前正与专业交易者进行系统测试。首批上市资产为比特币、以太坊、Solana、XRP和TRON；俄罗斯央行已开始登记加密交易运营商与托管商，Sberbank也计划同日推出加密产品。

title.en: Moscow Exchange Plans December 1 Crypto Trading Launch With BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, TRX
title.zh: 莫斯科交易所计划12月1日上线加密货币交易，首批含BTC、ETH、SOL、XRP、TRX

summary.en: The Solana Foundation announced that Samsung Wallet and Samsung Pay will support cross-border transfers using stablecoins on Solana. U.S. users can send USDC abroad from late October directly inside the wallet, with built-in fiat on- and off-ramps; the launch covers 82 million Galaxy devices, with Coinbase providing custody via Prime Vault. Foundation president Lily Liu called it a step toward stablecoins entering everyday use.
summary.zh: Solana基金会宣布，三星钱包 (Samsung Wallet) 与Samsung Pay将支持Solana链上的稳定币 (stablecoin) 跨境转账。美国用户自10月最后一周起可直接在钱包内用USDC向海外汇款，内置法币出入金通道；首批覆盖8,200万台Galaxy设备，Coinbase将通过Prime Vault提供托管支持。Lily Liu表示这是稳定币走向大众日常使用的关键一步。

title.en: Samsung Partners With Solana to Bring USDC Transfers to 82 Million Galaxy Devices
title.zh: 三星与Solana合作，8,200万台Galaxy设备将支持USDC跨境转账

summary.en: Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake urged the industry to plan for 'bunker mode' after OpenAI released 722 mathematics manuscripts, arguing AI could break the elliptic-curve signatures (ECDSA) securing Bitcoin and Ether wallets 'in months, not years,' and recommending an orderly migration of funds to fresh addresses. Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin responded that the risk is real but holders should not panic.
summary.zh: 以太坊基金会研究员Justin Drake在X上呼吁行业为“掩体模式 (bunker mode)”做准备：在OpenAI近日发布722份数学研究成果之后，他认为人工智能可能在“数月而非数年”内破解保护比特币与以太坊钱包的椭圆曲线签名 (ECDSA)，建议资金有序迁移至公钥从未暴露的新地址。以太坊联合创始人Vitalik Buterin回应称风险真实但无需恐慌。

title.en: Ethereum Researcher Justin Drake Urges 'Bunker Mode' as AI Could Crack Wallet Signatures Before Quantum
title.zh: 以太坊研究员Justin Drake呼吁为“掩体模式”做准备：AI或先于量子计算机破解钱包签名
比特币周五反弹1.8%至83,265美元，此前一度跌破81,000美元
title.en: Bitcoin Rebounds 1.8% to $83,265 on Friday After Thursday Slide Toward $80,000

summary.zh: 比特币周五（10月9日）反弹1.8%至83,265美元，此前周四交易时段曾跌至80,544美元，创下约两周半以来最低点。反弹受到美债收益率 (Treasury yields) 和油价回落的推动，市场押注中东局势有望缓和。本周加密市场全线下跌，24小时爆仓金额超过10.9亿美元，恐惧与贪婪指数 (Fear & Greed Index) 从72降至59。
summary.en: Bitcoin rose 1.8% to $83,265 on Friday, October 9, recovering after dropping to $80,544 during Thursday's session, its lowest level in about two and a half weeks. The rebound came as bond yields and oil prices retreated amid hopes for diplomatic progress in the Middle East. The week's selloff triggered over $1.09 billion in crypto liquidations in 24 hours, pushing the Crypto Fear & Greed Index down from 72 to 59.

title.zh: Ledger调查与马来西亚经销商CryptoBilis相关的钱包资金被盗事件
title.en: Ledger Investigates Wallet Drains Linked to Malaysian Reseller CryptoBilis

summary.zh: Ledger于10月9日宣布正在调查东南亚用户报告的资金被盗事件，受影响钱包据称购自马来西亚经销商CryptoBilis，公司已要求该经销商暂停一切销售。链上调查者Specter追踪到涉及比特币 (Bitcoin)、以太坊 (Ethereum) 和波场 (TRON) 的数百个受害钱包，估计损失超过8600万美元，但该数字尚未独立确认。Ledger尚未确认攻击方式，也不建议用户继续使用近90天内从该经销商购得的设备。
summary.en: Ledger said on October 9 it is investigating reports of funds drained from wallets bought through Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis, asking the reseller to pause all sales pending the probe. On-chain investigator Specter traced inflows to theft addresses from hundreds of victim wallets across Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron, estimating losses above $86 million — a figure not yet independently confirmed. Ledger has not confirmed the attack vector and advised users who bought devices from the reseller in the past 90 days to stop using them.

title.zh: SOL测试110-116美元关键支撑区，ETF资金流转负
title.en: SOL Tests $110–$116 Key Support Zone as ETF Flows Turn Negative

summary.zh: SOL在10月8日跌至约114.9美元，单日下跌2.5%，逼近110–116美元的关键日线支撑区间。压力主要来自ETF资金流转负：最近一周Solana现货ETF净流出113万美元，Bitwise的BSOL流出651万美元、Canary的SOLC流出478万美元，仅Grayscale的GSOL净流入538万美元部分对冲。若跌破该支撑区，下方支撑位见99–104美元。
summary.en: SOL fell to about $114.88 on October 8, down 2.5% over 24 hours, pressing against the closely watched $110–$116 daily support zone. The pressure came from reversed ETF flows: a $1.13 million net weekly outflow, with Bitwise's BSOL losing $6.51 million and Canary's SOLC $4.78 million, only partly offset by $5.38 million entering Grayscale's GSOL. A confirmed break of the zone would expose the $99–$104 demand area.

title.zh: 鹰派FOMC纪要叠加高油价：本周BTC周跌3.4%、ETH周跌8.4%
title.en: Hawkish FOMC Minutes and High Oil Prices Weigh on Crypto; BTC Down 3.4%, ETH Down 8.4% on the Week

summary.zh: 本周（10月2日至10月9日）加密货币市场先涨后跌：BTC从86,000美元上方回落，ETH从2,700美元上方大幅回落。宏观压力来自FOMC会议纪要显示多数与会者认为年底前再加息是合适的 (appropriate)，以及美国一年期通胀预期升至3.9%。据CoinGecko数据，BTC本周下跌3.4%至81,959美元，ETH下跌8.4%至2,481美元，山寨币表现弱于比特币。
summary.en: The crypto market rose then fell over the week of October 2–9: BTC retreated from above $86,000 while ETH pulled back sharply from above $2,700. Macro pressure came from hawkish FOMC minutes — most participants viewed another rate hike before year-end as appropriate — together with US one-year inflation expectations rising to 3.9%. CoinGecko data showed BTC down 3.4% to $81,959 on the week and ETH down 8.4% to $2,481, with altcoins underperforming Bitcoin.

title.zh: 比特币矿工迎来年内最好月份：9月收入11.2亿美元，算力逼近1 ZH/s
title.en: Bitcoin Miners Post Best Month Since January: September Revenue $1.12B as Hashrate Nears 1 ZH/s

summary.zh: 比特币挖矿9月收入达11.2亿美元，较8月增长11%，为1月以来最佳月份，反映挖矿经济回暖。网络算力 (Hashrate) 持续复苏：30日平均算力于10月1日达到944.6 EH/s，为6月中旬以来最高，7日估算值约983 EH/s，正重新逼近1 ZH/s大关。算力价格 (Hashprice) 回升至每PH/s每天40美元上方，为5月以来首次；挖矿难度 (Difficulty) 维持在132.72万亿左右，仍比一年前低约15%。
summary.en: Bitcoin miners earned $1.12 billion in September, up 11% from August and their best month since January, signaling improving mining economics. Network hashrate keeps recovering: the 30-day average hit 944.6 EH/s on October 1, its highest since mid-June, while the 7-day estimate stood near 983 EH/s, moving back toward the 1 zettahash-per-second threshold. Hashprice is back above $40 per PH/s per day for the first time since May; mining difficulty sits at 132.72 trillion, roughly 15% below where it was a year ago.

title.zh: French Hill：SEC与CFTC的加密规则不足以替代国会立法
title.en: French Hill: SEC and CFTC Crypto Rules Can't Replace Congressional Legislation

summary.zh: 众议院金融服务委员会主席French Hill在10月7日接受Fox Business采访时表示，SEC与CFTC的加密监管行动不足以 (falls short) 替代国会立法，机构规则容易被未来政府推翻，而《CLARITY Act》才能提供永久性的法律确定性。Hill表示仍希望在跛脚鸭会期 (lame-duck session) 通过该法案，届时参议院仅剩22个立法日。
summary.en: House Financial Services Committee Chair French Hill told Fox Business on October 7 that SEC and CFTC crypto rulemaking falls short of a legislative solution, warning agency rules can be reversed while a statute would endure.
